title: The Medal Rally's medals: res/medals/medals.json
description: ARCID_MEDAL_DEF (a/2/3/5), a file per medal (MedalDef in scrcmd_pokemon_center.c, MedalData in field/medal.h), MEDAL_COUNT of them in order. tools/data/medal_data.py packs them.

name.description: The medal's name, its message in res/text/system/medal_names.txt, whose messages are in the medals' order; the packer checks it and doesn't pack it

record.description: The record of the save data (RecordGet) that earns the medal when it reaches the threshold (PokemonCenter_CheckMedals); a medal has this or special

special.description: The check that earns the medal, an index into sMedalChecks of scrcmd_pokemon_center.c, stored as 10000 (MEDAL_CHECK_FIRST) plus it; a check that is NULL there leaves the medal to the scripts, which give it with Scrcmd_Medal_MedalGive

threshold.description: What the record or the check must reach

type.description: The medal's picture: the sequence of its cell actor (medalbox_data_sys.c, medal_info_viewer.c), its field effect after 0x4e (Scrcmd_Medal_MedalGetFieldEffectID), and by the table in PokemonCenter_GetMedalCategory its category, five types each from 0 and seven from 20

kind.description: 1 for a medal that Mr. Medal hints at while it is unknown, which DiscoverInitialMedalsCore discovers; the medals of 1 and 2 count toward their rank, and earning half of a rank's discovers those of 2 up to the rank after it (PokemonCenter_CheckMedals)

rank.description: The rank that the medal counts toward, of MEDAL_RANK_COUNT, whose names are res/text/system/medal_ranks.txt's

unk8.description: MedalDef.unk8, which the code doesn't read
